summary: Gareth Bramwell’s final commercial capacity review for 2017 planning, retained as a personal meeting copy. Covers how chamber occupancy and reserved pull windows are recorded and checked, and the assumptions required before quoting a start date. Client protocol results are excluded.

slides.title: Chamber capacity review 2017 — Rev02
slides.subtitle: Westravelle Analytical Ltd | Gareth Bramwell | 25 Nov 2016 | Personal meeting copy
slides.notes: Final review copy for 2017 planning. Kept on my laptop; use the live chamber and pull records when quoting.

slides.title: 1 Why we are looking at this
bullets: Commercial review for the next year: distinguish occupied storage, reservations and space available for new stability lots
Record occupancy by storage condition and stability lot in the chamber loading record; keep client analytical results out of the commercial summary
Check chamber space and analytical capacity before offering a start date

bullets.text: This review sets the booking checks; it does not certify current free capacity

slides.notes: For Alice and Leon at the quote review. Keep client result reports out of this copy.

slides.title: 2 Occupancy and reservations — source records

rows: Storage condition, occupied space and stability-lot locations
Identify usable space for the proposed storage condition
Proposed loading, reservation status and booking authority
Distinguish a reservation from confirmed loading
Reserved pull windows and scheduled sample withdrawals
Check the loading plan against scheduled work
Material that must remain after a pull
Do not assume a pull frees storage space

slides.notes: Read these together. A pull date alone is not a chamber vacancy date; remaining samples may still occupy the position.

slides.title: 3 Pull windows
bullets: Pull points and permitted windows follow the signed protocol
Coordinate sample handling within those windows without changing the required storage exposure
Late or missed pulls require a deviation note and an assessment of their effect
bullets_right: Review clustered pulls against analyst and method availability
Treat storage space and pull-testing capacity as separate booking constraints
Confirm reservations with Leon before offering a loading date
slides.notes: Use the current pull calendar, not dates copied into an old commercial slide.

slides.title: 4 Lead-time assumptions
bullets: Quote timing starts from the agreed prerequisites: signed protocol, sample receipt and confirmed storage allocation
State dependencies on chamber availability and analytical capacity in the quote
Treat any proposed expedited start as a separate capacity check before making a commitment

bullets.text: Confirm a start date from current booking records; this review supplies no standard lead-time figure

bullets: Saira to confirm method readiness and analytical availability for the planned pulls
slides.notes: No fixed loading interval is established here. Confirm with Alice if the requested timing depends on an exception to normal arrangements.

slides.title: 5 Quote review actions
bullets: Leon: confirm current occupancy, reservation status and the proposed pull windows from the source records
Saira: confirm analytical capacity and method readiness for those windows
Gareth: state the confirmed timing dependencies in the quotation
Alice: resolve capacity exceptions before a commercial commitment
slides.notes: My reminder: do not turn an old calendar entry into a promise. Earlier paper records are incomplete; use current confirmed bookings for 2017 planning.
